# Shaders 4.0.3

`shaders-4.0.3.js` is the unmodified, self-contained JavaScript ESM bundle published by
[Shader Effects Inc.](https://github.com/shader-effects-inc/shaders) at
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/shaders@4.0.3/dist/js/bundle.js.

It provides the site's full-screen FlowingGradient background. Loaded on demand from local
files; telemetry is disabled by the caller. No npm tooling is required to serve or
publish the blog. Refresh using `python3 scripts/vendor-assets.py`; asset source
URLs and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in `vendor/manifest.json`.

The Shaders MIT license is in `LICENSE`. The bundled TypeGPU runtime and its
dependencies retain their license texts under `licenses/` (MIT and Apache-2.0).
